description: This PHP test file is part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the JobCategoryDao class for managing job categories in the admin module. It sets up test data, and contains test cases to verify fetching lists and individual job categories by ID.

classes.name: JobCategoryDaoTest
classes.description: Test class for the JobCategoryDao, verifying retrieval of job categories and specific category details.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates JobCategoryDao instance, and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryList
methods.description: Verifies that the list of job categories fetched contains three entries.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryById
methods.description: Verifies that fetching a job category by ID returns a category with the expected name.
